import json
from rest_api import RestAPI

def post(api, payload):
    return json.loads(api.post("/iou", payload))

# 1. Sequential operations on one instance
db = {"users": [
    {"name": "Adam", "owes": {}, "owed_by": {}, "balance": 0.0},
    {"name": "Bob", "owes": {}, "owed_by": {}, "balance": 0.0},
]}
api = RestAPI(db)
assert post(api, {"lender": "Adam", "borrower": "Bob", "amount": 5.0})["users"][0]["owed_by"]["Bob"] == 5.0
# Bob pays back part by lending to Adam
post(api, {"lender": "Bob", "borrower": "Adam", "amount": 2.0})
post(api, {"lender": "Bob", "borrower": "Adam", "amount": 7.0})
users = {u["name"]: u for u in post(api, {"lender": "Adam", "borrower": "Bob", "amount": 1.0})["users"]}
assert users["Adam"]["owes"] == {"Bob": 3.0}, users
assert users["Bob"]["owed_by"] == {"Adam": 3.0}, users

# 2. lender/borrower names out of alpha order -> output sorted
db = {"users": [
    {"name": "Zoe", "owes": {}, "owed_by": {}, "balance": 0.0},
    {"name": "Al", "owes": {}, "owed_by": {}, "balance": 0.0},
]}
api2 = RestAPI(db)
res = post(api2, {"lender": "Zoe", "borrower": "Al", "amount": 1.0})
assert [u["name"] for u in res["users"]] == ["Al", "Zoe"]

# 3. DEFAULT database=None then add
api3 = RestAPI()
u = json.loads(api3.post("/add", json.dumps({"user": "X"})))
assert u == {"name": "X", "owes": {}, "owed_by": {}, "balance": 0.0}
# 4. duplicate add does not create second user
api3.post("/add", json.dumps({"user": "X"}))
assert api3.get("/users") == json.dumps({"users": [{"name": "X", "owes": {}, "owed_by": {}, "balance": 0.0}]})

# 5. subset getting with unsorted request yields sorted response
api4 = RestAPI({"users":[
    {"name": "B", "owes": {}, "owed_by": {}, "balance": 0.0},
    {"name": "A", "owes": {}, "owed_by": {}, "balance": 0.0},
    {"name": "C", "owes": {}, "owed_by": {}, "balance": 0.0},
]})
res = json.loads(api4.get("/users", json.dumps({"users": ["C", "A"]})))
assert [u["name"] for u in res["users"]] == ["A", "C"], res

# 6. balances recomputed with third-party debts untouched
api5 = RestAPI({"users": [
    {"name": "A", "owes": {"X": 2.5}, "owed_by": {}, "balance": -2.5},
    {"name": "B", "owes": {}, "owed_by": {"X": 2.0}, "balance": 2.0},
    {"name": "X", "owes": {}, "owed_by": {}, "balance": 0.0},
]})
res = post(api5, {"lender": "A", "borrower": "B", "amount": 1.25})
users = {u["name"]: u for u in res["users"]}
assert users["A"]["owes"] == {"X": 2.5} and users["A"]["owed_by"] == {"B": 1.25}
assert users["A"]["balance"] == -1.25
assert users["B"]["owes"] == {"A": 1.25} and users["B"]["owed_by"] == {"X": 2.0}
assert users["B"]["balance"] == 0.75

# 7. fractional amount and full payback netting to zero
api6 = RestAPI({"users": [
    {"name": "A", "owes": {"B": 0.3}, "owed_by": {}, "balance": -0.3},
    {"name": "B", "owes": {}, "owed_by": {"A": 0.3}, "balance": 0.3},
]})
res = post(api6, {"lender": "B", "borrower": "A", "amount": 0.1})

assert users["A"]["owes"] == {"B": 0.2}
assert users["B"]["owed_by"] == {"A": 0.2}
res = post(api6, {"lender": "A", "borrower": "B", "amount": 0.2})
users = {u["name"]: u for u in res["users"]}
assert users["A"]["owes"] == {} and users["A"]["owed_by"] == {}
assert users["B"]["owes"] == {} and users["B"]["owed_by"] == {}
assert users["A"]["balance"] == 0.0 and users["B"]["balance"] == 0.0

print("ALL EDGE TESTS PASSED")
